Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. K N CHOUDHURY, N GAUTAM,MS N MAHANTA,MR. D J DAS Advocate for the Respondent : GA, ASSAM, SC, NHAI,SC, NHIDC,SC, K A A C,SC, REVENUE
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY  ORDER 04.10.2024 Heard Mr. K. N. Choudhury, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. N. Gautam, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. J. Chutia, learned Standing Counsel, KAAC representing the respondent Nos. 2, 3 and 4 and Mr. S. S. Roy, learned counsel for the respondent No. 5, Mr. R.
Boro, learned counsel for the respondent No. 6, Mr. R. Page No.# 4/4 Borpujari, learned counsel for the respondent No. 1 and Mr. R. K. Talukdar, learned counsel for the respondent No. 7.

The petitioner is aggrieved by an order dated 27.03.2024 passed in Mutation Case No. 1427/2020 by the respondent No. 4 i.e. the Joint Secretary, Karibi Anglong Autonomous Council whereby, the claim of the petitioner as regards mutation was rejected.
Issue notice returnable after four weeks.
As the respondent Nos. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 are duly represented through their respective learned counsel, no formal notice need be issued to the said respondents.

sentences.text:
The petitioner to take steps for issuance of notice upon the respondents except the respondent Nos.
1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7, by way of registered post with A/D as well as by usual process within a period of five days from today.

Considering the order dated 16.09.2019 passed by this Court in a connected writ petition being WP(C) No. 6995/2019 filed by the petitioner, as an interim measure, it is provided that no payment of compensation shall be made on account of acquisition of land in question in favour of any party till the next date.

Mr. Chutia, learned Standing Counsel, KAAC may file affidavit in this regard and also keep the record pertaining to the impugned order dated 27.03.2024 passed in Mutation Case No. 1427/2020 ready for perusal of this Court.
List this matter after four weeks on a date to be fixed by the Registry.
